primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in whole liver fat at Week 16 and change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 16.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 16, whole-liver fat percent change was −3.21% with placebo, −16.12% with PF-06835919 150 mg, and −4.36% with 300 mg; reported p-values were 0.0696 and 0.0288. HbA1c changes were −0.14, −0.24, and −0.32, respectively; reported p-values were 0.6336 and 0.1266.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 0/54 placebo participants, 1/55 receiving PF-06835919 150 mg, and 0/55 receiving 300 mg; no deaths were reported.
